diff --git a/engine/rules.py b/engine/rules.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/engine/rules.py
+++ b/engine/rules.py
@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+def evaluate_rule(user, resource, action, context):
+    if user is None:
+        return False
+    if not user.get("active"):
+        return False
+    if resource is None:
+        return False
+    if action not in ("read", "write", "delete", "admin"):
+        return False
+    if action == "admin":
+        if user.get("role") != "admin":
+            return False
+        if not context.get("mfa_verified"):
+            return False
+        if context.get("ip_blocked"):
+            return False
+        if resource.get("type") == "sensitive":
+            if not user.get("clearance"):
+                return False
+            if user.get("clearance") < 3:
+                return False
+        return True
+    if action == "delete":
+        if resource.get("protected"):
+            return False
+        if user.get("role") not in ("admin", "editor"):
+            return False
+        if resource.get("owner") != user.get("id"):
+            if not user.get("can_delete_others"):
+                return False
+        return True
+    if action == "write":
+        if resource.get("locked"):
+            return False
+        if user.get("read_only"):
+            return False
+        return True
+    if action == "read":
+        if resource.get("private"):
+            if user.get("role") not in ("admin", "editor", "viewer"):
+                return False
+        return True
+    return False
